verdict.rationale: First-party docs show that Terraform imports existing infrastructure into state so it can be managed. They also state that the `import` block generates the accompanying configuration for imported resources. A community user corroborates that declarative import is now 'quite simple and safe.' Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the config-generation workflow and the fidelity of its output (only a single pointer sentence), and hands-on corroboration that generated code matches real resources.
